card.name: Word-initial L before lactic, lomitapide, lopinavir
card.fires_on: The letter L (or l) that starts a new word split into pieces, mainly in drug and warning terms like lactic acidosis, lomitapide, lopinavir and liver failure. It also fires on a stray 'j' in a Dutch sentence.
